newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Heijmans go-ahead for two Dutch projects.
newsitem.headline: Heijmans go-ahead for two Dutch projects.

text.p: Dutch builder Heijmans said on Tuesday it had gained the green light to start work on two major Dutch projects worth a total of 600 million guilders.

"Development combine 'De Nieuwe Hof'...will build a shopping centre combined with owner-occupied and rented housing and an underground parking garage. The share of the various Heijmans units in this project amounts to some 100 million guilders over two years," Heijmans said in a statement.
It said that in mid-1997 work would start on another project in Leidschendam near The Hague to build 6,800 houses and the associated infrastructure and public buildings.
"Heijmans' share in the consortium (undertaking the project) amounts to some 500 million guilders over a period of 10 years," the company said.
Heijmans said it was maintaining its earlier forecast of continued turnover growth and "clearly higher" profits in 1996.
